briefs.name: Amber Curls
briefs.brief: Warm brown skin, gentle rounded profile, and full natural curls gathered into a high puff with a soft cream headband.
briefs.detail: Warm rich medium-brown skin with golden undertones. Gentle rounded cheek and soft oval-to-round face, small graceful nose with a softly rounded tip, full warm rose-brown lips, delicate chin, subtle terracotta blush. Full natural dark espresso curls swept upward into a generous high puff with an organic curly silhouette, held by a soft plain cream fabric headband. The puff has several large readable curl groups and a few caramel-brown flat highlight shapes, not a single smooth ball. A couple of fine soft curls near the temple. The face must feel warmly kind, mature, serene and naturally pretty.
briefs.title: Design 1: Amber Curls
briefs.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: Inner Breeze Sun Salutation woman character redesign concept sheet, raster PNG, landscape approximately 1536 x 1024 (3:2).
Input images: Image 1 (reference-current-woman.png) is the exact wardrobe, body proportions, Mountain pose and flat illustration reference; its old face and hairstyle MUST be substantially redesigned. Image 2 (reference-current-poses.png) is supporting animation/style reference only; do not draw a pose grid.
Primary request: Create ONE beautiful polished concept sheet of ONE redesigned adult woman, shown twice consistently: a complete standing figure at left and a much larger head-and-neck profile close-up at right. Both views face RIGHT, both depict exactly the same identity, hair, skin and expression. Full figure occupies roughly left 42%, close-up occupies right 50%, with generous breathing room. Entire head/hair and bare feet of the left figure must be visible. The close-up shows her complete hairstyle without clipping. Keep both views below a single small tasteful title at top left.
Scene/backdrop: calm plain warm off-white background like the reference, with only a very soft flat oval under the full figure.
Style/medium: clean refined flat vector illustration as a bitmap, crisp smooth contours, no outlines around face/body/clothing, restrained soft flat shading using a few solid color shapes. Natural adult facial anatomy and kind serene beauty, not cartoonish, no chibi, no anime, no photorealism, no 3D, no painterly texture, no elaborate gradients.
Pose and body invariants: match reference's slim elongated adult proportions and quiet Mountain pose in strict right-facing side profile. Stand upright, feet together flat on the ground, palms pressed together at chest, shoulders relaxed. Hair may change the silhouette; body proportions and pose must not. Natural small hands with fingers together.
CLOTHING IS LOCKED: reproduce the reference's loose jade-green tunic (#3f8f7a), simple round neckline, long softly flared bell sleeves and gently flared upper-thigh hem; reproduce the loose straight navy trousers (#2e3d63), ankle length; barefoot. Match the reference garment construction, fit, hem length and flat shading. No wardrobe redesign, belt, sash, buttons, embroidery, pattern, jewelry or shoes. The close-up can show the same simple jade neckline at its base.
Face shared requirements: a substantially NEW, beautiful natural side profile with soft forehead, small refined nose, defined full softly resting lips and gentle chin. Calm fully CLOSED eye with visible delicate lashes, subtle natural blush appropriate to her skin tone, relaxed mouth, serene kind expression. Do not copy the original tiny geometric face or pointy hairstyle. Face shape, features, skin and hair should form a cohesive new identity.
Hair: polished readable flat masses with a few simple solid highlight shapes that read as glossy; keep each design's distinct real hair texture. Keep full-figure and close-up identities precisely consistent.
Avoid: extra characters, front or three-quarter views, open eyes, broad smile, exaggerated makeup, oversized eyes, generic copy of old bun, changed clothing, props, extra captions, swatches, logos or watermark.

briefs.name: Olive Flow
briefs.brief: Light olive skin, an elegant defined profile, and long glossy near-black hair in a high ponytail.
briefs.detail: Light olive skin with soft muted golden-green undertones. Elegant defined longer oval profile, softly sloping forehead, small refined straight nose, softly sculpted cheek, full muted rose lips, gentle tapered chin, discreet peach blush. Long glossy near-black hair smoothly gathered into a high ponytail at the back of the crown; a clear sweeping curved ponytail falls behind her neck toward the upper back, with a softly wavy tapered end and a believable swinging silhouette for yoga animation. Use a few broad dark charcoal-blue highlight ribbons, not individual rendered strands. A small natural wisp softens the temple. The high ponytail must look clearly different from a bun; match its length and shape in both views. Beautiful serene natural adult profile.

briefs.name: Midnight Braids
briefs.brief: Deep dark skin, a graceful long neck and softly sculpted profile, with braids gathered in a low bun and a few loose braids.
briefs.detail: Deep dark rich brown skin with balanced warm undertones and luminous flat warm-brown highlight planes. Graceful long neck within the reference's overall slim proportions, softly sculpted high cheek, soft forehead, a small natural gently rounded nose, defined full plum-brown lips and softly rounded chin. Subtle warm berry blush visible without lightening her skin. Dark finely grouped braids sweep back from a natural hairline into a low braided bun at the nape, with two or three slender braids hanging beside/behind the ear and along the neck. Express braid groupings with clean simple interlocking flat shapes and a few graphite-brown highlights, no line-art outline or photoreal detail. The bun is visibly low at the nape, not on top of her head. Her expression is serene, gentle and naturally beautiful.

briefs.name: Auburn Dawn
briefs.brief: Fair rosy skin with light freckles, a soft heart-shaped profile, and auburn waves in a loose messy bun with bangs and face-framing strands.
briefs.detail: Fair rosy skin with natural pink undertones, a light scattering of small soft cinnamon freckles across the visible upper cheek and bridge of the nose, subtle soft rose blush. Soft heart-shaped facial structure shown in strict profile, softly rounded forehead, small refined gently upturned nose, defined full dusty-rose lips, gentle petite chin. Rich auburn wavy hair in an airy loose messy bun, soft curved bangs swept across the upper forehead without hiding the closed eye, and two delicate wavy face-framing strands. Use warm copper and chestnut flat highlight shapes to reveal the waves and glossy bun loops. It should look intentionally soft and natural, not the reference's solid pointy fringe/topknot or a neat tight bun. Serene kind pretty adult identity.

selected.source_prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Extract the EXACT woman's head and hairstyle from the large right-hand portrait in the provided approved "Design 4: Auburn Dawn" image, as a high-resolution animation cutout on a genuinely transparent background.
Preserve her identity and visual quality precisely: fair rosy skin, light cinnamon freckles, soft natural beautiful right-facing side profile, small refined nose, gently full NATURAL BARE LIPS barely darker than her skin, no lipstick or makeup, serene closed eye with delicate lashes, soft subtle blush. Preserve the exact rich auburn wavy loose messy bun, swept soft bangs and the fine wavy face-framing strands, including the copper flat highlight shapes. Use the refined flat vector illustration style of this exact image, not crude geometric shapes. This is the same woman, not a new interpretation.
Output ONLY ONE head, all its hair and a short bare neck stump, in strict profile facing RIGHT, upright as in the portrait. Include the ENTIRE messy bun, flyaways, bangs and face-framing strands with comfortable transparent margin on every side. The neck should end just below the hanging face-framing strands so it can overlap the animation's bare neck. Remove all clothes, jade neckline, body, original smaller figure, title, background and shadow. No text, no duplicates, no circle crop, no frame. The entire canvas outside the actual character must have alpha transparency. Aim for a tightly framed square 1024x1024 PNG with a naturally preserved neck connection. Keep her expression, nose, jaw, freckles and bare-lip colour exactly like the approved source.
selected.natural_face_refinement:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Correct this transparent right-facing woman's head cutout for a calm yoga animation. The owner says the face still looks made-up and the loose hair looks strange. Make her naturally pretty and understated, with absolutely NO MAKEUP, and a coherent compact hairstyle.
FACE: retain a beautiful natural adult right-facing profile, fair light European skin, small refined nose and gentle chin, calm CLOSED eye and a few faint cinnamon freckles. Her skin should be even and softly warm, with only two restrained flat shading tones; remove all pink/orange cheek blush, cosmetic contouring and facial highlights. Her CLOSED EYELID must be one very fine muted brown curve, with at most two tiny fine natural lashes; REMOVE the thick black eyelash/eyeliner wedge and wing. No mascara effect, eyeshadow or eyeliner. Her eyebrow should be a delicate soft natural light auburn brow, not a heavy dark filled arch. NATURAL BARE LIPS: almost the same pale beige-peach tone as her skin, very low saturation and matte, a barely visible mouth seam. No lipstick, lip liner, pink/red/coral colour, gloss, pout, dark mouth outline or sharply defined cosmetic lips. Keep her attractive, kind and serene, with natural face proportions, not a doll or cartoon.
HAIR: keep auburn wavy hair and a recognizable loose bun, with a few simple copper flat highlight shapes. Make the bun about 20% more compact and coherent, anchored visibly to the back/top of the hair. REMOVE detached loops, oversized flyaways, long wisps under the jaw, dangling curls reaching down the neck and isolated hair pieces. Keep just one or two short soft attached wisps near the temple, above the jaw. All hair belongs to one cohesive silhouette; nothing floating or separate. This cutout will rotate with her head as one anchored piece, so do not draw motion or floating locks.
PRESERVE: strict right-facing side profile; upright head; short bare neck stump; entire head and all hair in view with generous transparent margins; refined clean flat-vector illustration style and crisp edges; only ONE isolated head; genuinely transparent alpha outside the character. No clothing, body, background, text, shadow, outlines, 3D or photorealistic rendering. Do not add any new accessories or makeup.
selected.jaw_edge_refinement:

Make ONE surgical transparency edit to this exact transparent head image for animation. REMOVE THE BARE NECK BELOW THE JAW entirely. The image will be composited over an existing drawn neck, and its current pale diagonal neck stump creates a visible seam.
Erase all bare neck skin beneath the anatomical underside of the jaw: follow the natural jaw/under-chin silhouette from behind/below the ear to the chin, and make the entire neck below that contour fully alpha-transparent. Keep a clean antialiased jaw edge. The retained asset must be ONLY the head, face, ear and complete auburn bun/hair, with NO neck stump, NO shoulder, NO diagonal skin cutoff and NO pale skin patch below the jaw. Preserve the compact attached hair.
Preserve the artwork above that cut EXACTLY, without redrawing it: same face, eye, delicate soft brown closed lid, freckles, barely coloured natural bare lips, natural fair skin with no blush/makeup, nose, jaw silhouette, chin, ear, auburn wavy hair and compact bun. Do not add makeup or flyaways. Most importantly, retain the exact original 1254x1254 canvas and exact pixel scale and placement of the retained head/hair. DO NOT enlarge, shrink, recenter, shift or rotate anything. Leave the removed neck area as transparent empty space in its original position. Keep the remaining background genuinely transparent.
Output the same image with ONLY the neck removed at the jaw line. No text or other changes.
